arabic text: FATIMA DA LADLA MAQTAL DE PASAY TUR PAYA
english translation text: THE MOON OF ZAHRA MOVES TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: JISM TAY MAZLOOM DE PHATEYA LIBAAS AY TUR PAYA
english translation text: THE CLOTHES OF HUSSAIN (A.S.) ARE ALL TORN AND IN PIECES WHILE HE WALKS TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: QAFILA KAR KE HAWALAY ABID E BEEMAR DE\nRONDIYAAN BEHNAAN NU OH DENDA DILASAY TUR PAYA
english translation text: THE CARAVAN IS NOW IN THE HANDS OF SAJJAD (A.S)\nWHILST COMFORTING HIS TEARFUL SISTERS HE NOW GOES TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: BAAD GHAZI DE KAMAR KHAM HO GAYEE SHABBIR KI\nFER VI MAQTAL VICHO AY CHAAN LASHAY TUR PAYA
english translation text: AFTER ABBAS WAS MARTYRED THE BACK OF HUSSAIN (A.S) WAS BROKEN, HE STILL WENT TO THE BATTLEFIELD AND PICKED UP THE BODIES

arabic text: CHA KE ASGHAR NU HATHAN TE ASHKIA DI FOUJ VAL\nZULM O ISTABDAD DE KHOLAN KHULASAY TUR PAYA
english translation text: CARRYING ASGHER IN HIS ARMS, HE MOVES TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: ENJ DI AKHTAR GHAREEBI CHA GAYI MAZLOOM TAY\nCHOOR KAY WICH KHAMIYAN DAY BAAL PYASAY TUR PAYA
english translation text: OH AKHTAR HOW CAN I EXPLAIN HOW OPPRESSED OUR IMAM (A.S) WAS,\nHE LEFT BEHIND THE THIRSTY CHILDREN AND LEFT FOR THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: CHOOR KE GHAR BAAR MIL KAY NAAL BEHNA BETIAN\nAHMED E MUKHTAR NU KAR KE UDAAS AY TUR PAYA
english translation text: LEAVING HIS HOME, ALONG WITH HIS SISTERS AND DAUGHTERS,\nMAKING THE PROPHET SORROWFUL, HE MOVES TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD
